Hello voaters, I would like to warmly invite you all to join us on the Netfuze IRC network! A year ago, I revived a network I first tried starting in 2009, Netfuze. At Netfuze, we are a peaceful community of geeks who enjoy chatting about tech and enjoying root beers together. We're still small, but we've grown a lot since the early days, and we would like you to come and be a part of us.

Join us in #coldflame for general chat, or head on over to one of our tech-related channels. In #TechNews we have feeds from various tech sites keeping you up to speed on the latest tech news! We emphatically welcome all to start their own channels and bring their own users, so long as the peace is kept and the rules are followed. We also allow relay bots (just let us know first, please) to channels on other networks.

One thing Netfuze has that is unique to us is NewsBot, which powers #TechNews and other channels. NewsBot, a bot I wrote, pulls articles from RSS feeds and displays their titles, descriptions, and links in assigned channels at regular intervals. The bot will gather articles from all its sources, merge them and sort them by time, and then present any new articles since the last time it checked to the channel in the order of oldest to newest. You can see the commands for how to do this on our Wiki page here: http://netfuze.net/wiki/index.php/NewsBot.

Connect to irc.netfuze.net:6667 or +6697 for SSL - We use Unreal and Anope 2 We support IPv6 on alpha.netfuze.net and SASL on both alpha and beta.

J|D

My world of Vitean (meaning life giver) is currently in the third age. It is based on the premise of cycles. Magic or Vitae is created by all living things and flows about the planet in currents. As the amount of Vitae increases it leads to a positive feedback loop and more life is created. This continues until magic becomes so plentiful that mages are capable of wreaking great destruction on the world. Inevitably a war breaks out and decimates humanity, the landscape, and the planet itself. Vitae wanes in the aftermath and humans are left to pick up the pieces in a nearly mundane world. Technology begins to advance during these several hundred years until the Vitae current regains strength. Magic then displaces technology in society until another collapse comes. This cycle is the driving factor in my world as it effects everything from politics to army equipment to tactics to farming.
